text:
marta: Heads-up — prepping release notes for 2.11.2 (runtime micro-optimizations + routing fallback bugfix). Need docs/ops/legal eyes by EOD so I can pin and schedule the deploy. Pin target: 2024-11-20 15:00 PT. Deploy window: 2024-11-21 01:00-05:00 UTC. Who can run final smoke? Any regional embargo needs (APAC legal)? :globe_with_meridians:
jen: From docs: please add a short compatibility note about the SDK behavior change (new `truncate` semantics) and include a curl example. Also keep the pin wording as "version pin (artifact)" per previous guidance.
sam: Ops request: add explicit rollback thresholds and the exact revert tag. Recommend: rollback if 1) client error rate > 2% sustained for 5m, OR 2) p95 token latency > 180ms for 10m. Revert tag: `revert/2.11.2`. Add step-by-step revert commands in the runbook.
alvin: I can run smoke for the US region 01:00-03:00 UTC. Will test health endpoints, 4 generation prompts (short/long/edge), 2 embedding samples, and KV cache warmup. If APAC coverage needed I can coordinate with the oncall there.
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary plan uploaded: 4% -> 30% -> 100% with 12m ramps. Auto-rollback if canary error rate delta > 1.4% vs baseline or p95 delta > 160ms. Preview: `/deploy start v2.11.2 --canary=4 --ramp=12m --annotations="internal-announce:pending,ops-runbook:attached"`
marta: Added rollback thresholds, revert tag, and Dedicated customer note about quiesce/pinned artifacts. Draft link: https://docs.internal/releases/2.11.2-draft — please add inline comments. I also added a one-paragraph security note for legal to skim.
jen: Pushed a tiny wording tweak and curl snippet: `curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-1","input":"hi","truncate":true}'`
sam: I9ll draft the internal-announce message. Plan: send to `internal-announce` automatically when canary hits 30%, plus a manual follow at 60% if stable. Include ops runbook bullets and who to ping (ops-rotation, eng-oncall, legal).
alvin: Smoke checklist approved. I9ll paste the logs here during/after run. If any routing fallback regressions show up in APAC tests, I will trigger `revert/2.11.2` and notify ops-sre.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: Deploy scheduled to start 2024-11-21T01:00:00Z. Manifest `manifest-2.11.2.json` attached. Canary annotations set to trigger internal announce at 30% step.
marta: Confirming I will pin draft at 2024-11-20 15:00 PT unless objection. Reminder to show UTC + PT in the pinned blurb and to include Dedicated FAQ link.
jen: Docs sign-off  tiny clarity tweak done.
sam: Comms sign-off  will post localized APAC/EU lines.
alvin: No objections. I9ll post smoke logs here once done.
marta: Thanks everyone 44d I9ll set the deploybot annotation to `internal-announce:pending` so the announce runs automatically when canary reaches 30%.
